description:
List a TikTok user's public videos, newest first (1 credit per page).

        Args:
            username: TikTok username (with or without @) or profile URL
            limit: Videos per page (default 15, max 30)
            cursor: The cursor returned by the previous page, to get the next one
name: list_tiktok_user_videos
title: List TikTok user videos
